Set the user agent used for NADA requests

Source: R/http_helpers.R.R
set_user_agent.Rd

Sets the User-Agent header sent with every request to the NADA catalogs for the rest of the R session. By default nadaverse sends a browser user agent, because some catalogs, such as UNHCR, reject requests from other clients. Use this function to send a different agent, for example one that identifies your project. If a catalog starts rejecting requests after you change the agent, call set_user_agent(NULL) to go back to the default.

Usage

set_user_agent(user_agent = NULL)

Arguments

user_agent

A single non-empty string to send as the user agent, or NULL to restore the default browser user agent.

Value

Invisibly, the previous setting: NULL when the default was in use. Pass it back to set_user_agent() to restore it.

Details

The setting is stored in the nadaverse.user_agent option.

See also

catalogs

Examples

# Send a custom user agent for this session
old <- set_user_agent("My research project (nadaverse)")

# Restore the default browser user agent
set_user_agent(NULL)
